# {{ site.title }}

Tagline: {{ site.tagline }}

> ChessDepth is a chess company based in Bhopal, India. Its coaching arm, ChessDepth Academy, teaches live online chess classes to children (from about age 5) and adults, from complete beginners to tournament players, with FIDE-rated coaches including Grandmaster Daniel Gormally. Students join from India and abroad. ChessDepth also builds its own training tools: the Chess Lab (68 courses, puzzles, endgame and positional training), a daily chess puzzle, a blindfold chess trainer, a screenshot-to-FEN tool (ChessDepth AI), free printable worksheets and a chess blog.

Key facts:

- Format: live online classes over video with a shared board. Small groups of 2 to 4 students, or one-to-one.
- Fees: group classes ₹2,999 (or $60 for students outside India) per month; one-to-one classes from ₹5,600 (or $90 for students outside India) per month, depending on the coach. Prices are inclusive of all taxes. Each monthly plan has 8 to 10 live classes of 60 to 70 minutes. The first demo class (30 minutes) is free.
- Levels: Beginner (up to 1000), Intermediate (1000 to 1500), Advanced (1500 to 1900) and Elite (1900+), the same in one-to-one and group classes. Students are placed by level after the free demo class.
- Included: worksheets, a quiz every 8 sessions with coach feedback, club tournaments on Lichess and Chess.com, and a student area with PDF material.
- Ages: children from about 5 years old, teenagers and adults.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone {{ site.contact.phone_display }}, email {{ site.contact.email }}. Book a free demo class at {{ site.url }}/#inquiry
- Location: {{ site.contact.address }} (classes are online, worldwide).

## Classes and coaching

- [Online chess classes for kids]({{ site.url }}/chess-classes-for-kids/): parents' guide to the kids' classes: ages, what children learn, fees, how the free demo works, FAQ.
- [Classes and fees]({{ site.url }}/courses/): the two class formats (one-to-one personalised training and group classes of 2 to 4), the four levels (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Elite) and monthly fees.
- [Curriculum]({{ site.url }}/curriculum/): the full syllabus, four levels with three stages each, every topic, the quiz at the end of each stage, study material and how students move up.
- [Coaches]({{ site.url }}/coaches/): the coaching team with FIDE ratings and profile links.
- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/): mission, teaching method, curriculum levels and student reviews.
- [Contact and free demo class]({{ site.url }}/contact/): phone, WhatsApp and email.

## Free tools

- [Blindfold chess trainer]({{ site.url }}/blindfold/): free browser trainer with 10 visualization drills, a 28-day plan, a daily blindfold puzzle and blindfold games against Stockfish (400 to 2800 Elo).
- [Daily chess puzzle]({{ site.url }}/#daily): a new puzzle from a real game every day, easier on Monday and harder by Sunday.
- [ChessDepth AI]({{ site.url }}/ai/): turns a chess screenshot or book diagram into a board and FEN, in the browser.
- Classes for families outside India, with time differences, fees in US$ and payment in local currency: [USA and Canada]({{ site.url }}/online-chess-classes-usa/), [Dubai and the UAE]({{ site.url }}/online-chess-classes-uae/), [Saudi Arabia]({{ site.url }}/online-chess-classes-saudi-arabia/), [Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain]({{ site.url }}/online-chess-classes-qatar/), [UK and Europe]({{ site.url }}/online-chess-classes-uk/), [Singapore and Southeast Asia]({{ site.url }}/online-chess-classes-singapore/).
- [Free chess resources]({{ site.url }}/lab/resources/): study roadmap, a free printable chess score sheet (A4 and US Letter PDF), Lichess game analyser, board editor, opening guide, endgame checklist and book list.
- [Chess Lab]({{ site.url }}/lab/): 68 courses including interactive lessons on chess thinking, strategy and pawn structures, a dedicated positional-play section ({{ site.url }}/lab/positional/), a tactics trainer, Depth Dive, timed Depth Sprint, 26 opening courses, an endgame trainer against Stockfish, a coordinates trainer and a progress dashboard.
